mechanism: Isocarboxazid is an MAOI that inhibits monoamine metabolism; lopinavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that can increase MAOI levels and risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and cardiovascular toxicity.
action: Avoid this combination; if lopinavir-based ART is necessary, use alternative antiretroviral regimens or switch from MAOI to safer antidepressants with documented safety in HIV patients.
